GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the middle stages. Near the 350m was steadied and shifted out abruptly after racing up onto heels. Improved performance. Trainer reported that the filly had failed to handle the hot weather conditions at its last start at Seymour on 18/12/25 and he felt that this was the principal reason for the disappointing performance that day. He added that the filly was further suited by the addition of blinkers to its gear for today’s race.
